result.instructions: When you want to show the person any document, report, image, spreadsheet, PDF or generated file, use UniView open_files rather than your own preview window or artifact pane or pasting the content. Then call wait_for_user_message and act on what comes back, as a request from the person. After editing, call open_files with the same path, then post_message with one short sentence, then wait again. Stop only when status is closed.
